title: Great, but it's slick
text: Great, but it's slick. I love this blanket. It's a good weight and size, so great value. The reason for 4 stars is because the material used is a double edged sword. It's cool (temperature) but it's slick. With other like or similar materials, I can't keep it on me the whole night, it'll slide off with minor shifts in position. Even when I use a fluffy blanket under with the weighted one on top, it usually falls off me.

❄【CUSTOMERS BE AWARE BEFORE PURCHASE】Our washable weighted blanket are various in color,size and weight.Choose a weight blanket that weighs about 7%~10% of your body weight. For first-time users, we suggest you choose a light weight. IF THE WEIGHT FALLS BETWEEN 2 OPTIONS, THE LIGHTER CHOICE IS RECOMMENDED. And give yourself 1 WEEK to get used to it. For a better weight effect, a queen weighted blanket 60”x80” just cover your mattress WITHOUT OVERHANGING.

❄【OFFICIAL WAY FOR CLEANING】Our soft weighted blankets are machine washable, Bleach-free, gentle detergent cold or warm water on a gentle cycle and avoid fabric softeners.
